verdict.rationale: Honeycomb supports routing Trigger and SLO alert notifications to custom webhooks with JSON payloads, which lets an AI-native user subscribe to specific alerting events. However this is limited to triggers/SLO conditions rather than a general-purpose event subscription system covering arbitrary telemetry or object changes, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook reliability. missing for 10: broader event-type coverage beyond triggers/SLOs, independent verification of webhook delivery in practice.
